title: Scarab God of Chains
description: A large black scarab beetle deity with horns, flaming torch, and chain crown stands split across a torn vertical divide. The left side shows the beetle against a light background with occult symbols, while the right side depicts a dark scene of hooded worshippers kneeling before a flaming altar piled with coins and rings.
prompt: A surreal dark fantasy scene split by a jagged vertical tear. On the left, a massive black scarab beetle god with horns, glowing white eyes, and occult markings stands against a pale background with swirling symbols, holding a flaming torch and a chain crown with fire. On the right, a black background shows hooded worshippers kneeling around a towering pile of golden coins and rings topped with a blazing brazier, occult symbols float in the air.
